purpose: Native GRADE cage counts on perfect GenIce2 crystals, used by src/grade/tests.rs. These are the reference tool's own counts, not the ideal counts.
native_build: g++ -O2 -ffp-contract=off (IEEE arithmetic, as in the x86-64 Dockerfile); an arm64 build with fused multiply-add also reads 468 5^12 cages on the 444_S2 crystal, which is not a fixture here
native_input: copy of each file with residue SOL and atoms OW HW1 HW2 MW (a copy of OW is the MW site when the source has three sites); oxygen coordinates are untouched
